# Legado reader attribution

Reader UI, CSS, settings, icons and interaction helpers in `src/components/legado-reader` are adapted from https://github.com/lukelzlz/legado-server at commit 58c0de5e8adcaa13e8fe9f540867f34b671629b2 (GPL-3.0). See the accompanying complete license. Modifications: Hub data/progress adapter, current-chapter fetching, scoped CSS, per-user settings and removal of unsupported backend controls. The derived frontend must be distributed under GPL-3.0 with corresponding source; the upstream Hub MIT notice remains applicable to its original code.
